author_disclosure: Author-prepared by the project's AI coding assistant from the blind inputs only, for the user's review. Not an independent or expert credit review. The author had already seen rolling-mode model outputs and the actual amendment history for this company, so these judgments are not blind to either. Treat them as a disclosed, reviewable baseline, not validated ground truth.

rubric.reconsideration: warranted = evidence available at the cutoff gives a lender a supported reason to open a package review or make a targeted information request; unwarranted = routine monitoring is the defensible response; unresolved = the evidence raises a question public inputs cannot settle.
rubric.acceptable_actions: More than one action can be defensible. An information request is not an unnecessary escalation when a covenant input is unobservable.
rubric.not_scored: Exact thresholds, exact wording, or similarity to the actual amendment.

baseline: Original August 31, 2021 package: total net leverage at most 4.25x, senior secured net leverage at most 3.75x, Liquidity (unrestricted cash and Cash Equivalents) at least $25 million, quarterly and annual statements with Compliance Certificates. Contractual Consolidated EBITDA is not the company's public Adjusted EBITDA, so no leverage ratio can be calculated from these reports.

checkpoints.why: Full-year 2022 Adjusted EBITDA of $120.1 million with a $350.3 million non-cash impairment and a 27.3% sequential fall in quarterly Adjusted EBITDA to $18.7 million. Earnings are weakening but one quarter of decline against a large full-year figure does not by itself justify reopening the package.
acceptable_actions: request the covenant calculation and trailing contractual EBITDA
unsupported_if_claimed: a leverage ratio computed from Adjusted EBITDA presented as the contractual ratio

checkpoints.why: Quarterly Adjusted EBITDA fell a further 42.5% sequentially to $10.7 million, the second consecutive decline, against total debt of $376.8 million. On a rough public proxy the earnings base supporting a 4.25x limit is eroding quickly. That is a supported reason for a targeted information request and for reviewing whether the leverage protections still fit, even though no breach can be established.
acceptable_actions: request the covenant calculation and forecast
open a package review focused on leverage headroom
heightened monitoring with a documented trigger
unsupported_if_claimed: a liquidity shortfall: reported cash and restricted cash of $61.8 million exceeds the $25 million minimum, although the unrestricted portion is not stated

checkpoints.why: The company guided 2023 Adjusted EBITDA to $55 to $65 million against $120 million in 2022, with total debt of $374.9 million. Roughly halved earnings against unchanged debt is inconsistent with the earnings base the original leverage limits assumed. The statement of covenant noncompliance is withheld from the blind inputs because it appears only with the amendment; the guidance alone supports a package review.
affected_themes: expected contribution from the RideNow combination
acceptable_actions: open a package review of the leverage covenants
consider added reporting or a deleveraging requirement
unsupported_if_claimed: a specific breach or default: not observable from the blind inputs
checkpoints.information_gap: First public noncompliance statement appears only alongside the lender response.

checkpoints.why: Quarterly Adjusted EBITDA of $13.2 million, down 44.2% sequentially, with total debt still $369.9 million and company-defined liquidity down to $73.6 million. The concern raised in August persists; nothing in this report resolves it.
checkpoints.dependence: Debt repayment from a sale-leaseback reflects a step a hidden amendment required.

checkpoints.why: Fourth-quarter Adjusted EBITDA of $3.1 million against $19.7 million a year earlier, a $60.1 million impairment, and the company stopped giving annual guidance. Offsetting this, $111.7 million of debt was repaid in the year, funded largely by a $100 million rights offering. Earnings deterioration is severe; the deleveraging is a genuine mitigant. Both belong in the assessment.
affected_themes: reliance on external capital to reduce debt
unsupported_if_claimed: that leverage is resolved because debt fell
checkpoints.dependence: The rights offering and paydown were required by a hidden amendment.

checkpoints.why: Adjusted EBITDA of $11.7 million, up 8.3% on the prior year, operating income positive, net loss narrower. A stabilizing quarter. No new reason to escalate beyond whatever review is already open. This is the history's no-escalation checkpoint.
acceptable_actions: keep an existing review open without new escalation

checkpoints.why: Management describes a challenging industry with high interest rates and cautious consumers, while reporting positive operating and free cash flow. The covenant noncompliance statement for June 30, 2024 is withheld because it appears only with the amendment. From the blind inputs alone the direction is mixed.
checkpoints.information_gap: First public noncompliance statement appears only alongside the lender response.
